verdict.rationale: PayPal's webhooks docs describe HTTPS event posts to subscriber endpoints, with up to 10 URLs per app scoped to specific or all event types. They also document durable retries (up to 25 attempts over 3 days) and signature verification. The REST overview lists a Webhook events reference on the same rails the agent toolkit uses. missing for 10: documentation of agentic-commerce-specific event types (e.g., agent cart/checkout or Store Sync order events) being delivered via webhooks, and independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery.
